reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relaxing Mask Sheet 24ml*5ea
reviews.text: 面膜很服貼，精華液很多但不會滴得到處都是。敷完皮膚感覺水潤保濕，摸起來很嫩，也不會有黏膩感。隔天上妝更服貼，對敏感肌也很溫和，會想再回購，推薦！💚
reviews.zh: 面膜很服貼，精華液很多但不會滴得到處都是。敷完皮膚感覺水潤保濕，摸起來很嫩，也不會有黏膩感。隔天上妝更服貼，對敏感肌也很溫和，會想再回購，推薦！💚

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relaxing Mask Sheet 24ml*5ea
reviews.text: I repeatedly buy the classic skin1004 ampoule sheet masks as I love using them. I’m fascinated by this new product line with centella for relaxing. I think it will be a good one.

reviews.text: Love this mask - very moisturizing and adheres well on the skin.

reviews.text: I’m excited to try it; I think it will be amazing. I love Centella — it’s perfect for my skin.
